description: A roof over a room (its id or name) or an outline (wall centre lines, mm). roofType gable (default), hip, shed or flat; pitch in degrees (default 30); overhang past the wall centre lines (default 400 mm); thickness (default 180 mm). It sits on the tallest wall of the level unless eave (mm above the level floor) says where; walls under it are cut to its slope, and attachTop on a wall (update_element) runs it up to the roof. L, T and U shaped rooms get joined roofs with valleys.

items.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

room.description: Room id or name (or give outline)
